The Slow Sunday Issue.

A food and culture magazine with warm editorial photography, readable essays and a distinctive recipe layout.

Large food photographs punctuate the issue, while two-column essays and an offset ingredient panel establish a varied reading rhythm. Red serif headlines carry the editorial identity across market stories, recipes and hosting notes.
